verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair question for a GPU, since companion driver software could ship one, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no AI assistant in the card's AMD Software. HYPR-RX one-click profiles are an adjacent control, not a task-delegating assistant. ROCm support for vLLM and llama.cpp is a developer building block for running your own models, not a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
